subject: ventures/interview-content-studio
professional: a senior social media / content strategist who plans multi-platform calendars for small businesses; first checks: are the platform limits right as the platforms count them (X weighted length, Bluesky graphemes), is the plan honest about the hours it costs, does the scheduler CSV import cleanly, can the tool put a claim in the client's mouth they did not make, and would the drafts survive first contact (hook length on short video, Reddit self-promotion rules)

evidence.correctness: Recomputed against tools and arithmetic the author did not write (scratchpad/interview-content-studio/scripts/). (1) Platform limits: a full 14-platform interview at 20 h/week (161 drafts, `node scripts/en.mjs`) checked with twitter-text 3.1.0 parseTweet().weightedLength for every X post and thread part, graphemer 1.4.0 for Bluesky, and plain lengths for Threads/LinkedIn/Instagram/YouTube/Pinterest: 0 violations; the tool's X measure equals twitter-text on ASCII with a URL (48 = 48) and accented Latin (41 = 41). (2) planCadence for LinkedIn + Instagram + newsletter at 3 h/week computed by hand from FORMATS (720 min budget; step 1 100 min, floors to 540, ideals stop at 705): LinkedIn 6, feed 6, reel 5, carousel 3, newsletter 2, 176 min/week; the engine gives exactly that. (3) CSV: the CLI's 161-row export parsed by Python's csv module: 162 rows, all 5 columns; csvCell neutralises =, +, -, @, TAB, CR per the OWASP CSV-injection list and leaves '-5' alone. (4) Spoken-length estimate: a reel of 51 words at 150 wpm = 20.4 s by hand; tool says 'about 20 seconds'. (5) No template draft contains a number absent from the interview except the tool's own '150 words a minute' / '15 seconds' metadata. Where it is wrong: non-Latin text. With a CJK/emoji-heavy interview (`node scripts/x.cjs`), 8 of 32 generated X posts exceed 280 by twitter-text (max weighted 456), because measure('x') counts code points and X weights CJK and emoji 2; the code comment admits it (studio.mjs:292), the README and page do not. Capped at 3, not 4, by that and by the AI number gate's gaps (claims).
evidence.completeness: Every README feature walked end to end. CLI: --questions, --format md/csv/json/plan, --interview by topic case-insensitive, exit 2 on a bad date (2026-02-30), missing file and unknown format. Page, in headless Chrome with playwright-core (`node scripts/page.cjs`, served by python http.server): JSON import ('Imported 1 interview.'), build gives 18 plan rows, 161 drafts and the hours line; CSV download has 161 data rows; filter; AI box with Anthropic and a test key against a route-mocked api.anthropic.com (no real call): 22 shown drafts in 5 calls, 13 rewritten, 9 kept the built-in wording (the 5 seeded '500%' pieces among them); no page errors. Export note, disclaimer, posting rules, opt-out present. Gaps: 'Podcast clip clip' in the CLI plan and in plan notes (row name built as platformName + format name); OpenAI/Gemini with no model typed leaves the button enabled and reports 'AI is off: no provider configured' (ai.mjs:142), which is wrong for a user who picked a provider and key.
evidence.verification: `node --test '*.test.mjs'`: 49 pass, 0 fail, 0.24 s (README's bare `node --test` also passes 49). Eight seeded mutants through quality_mutate.py: caught were X link weight 23->20, weekday-only filter Sat->Fri, budget +60 min, Reddit-link gate disabled, offer every 4th->2nd angle, extra allowed numbers in the AI gate; survived were dropping '@' from the CSV formula guard (studio.mjs:824) and the speaking rate 150->100 wpm (studio.mjs:738). 6 of 8 caught. ai.test.mjs exercises the BYOK path with a stub fetch (prompt contents, JSON parsing, invented-number drop, Reddit link, batch sizing, HTTP 500 fallback) and pins byok.mjs to platform/llm/byok.mjs byte for byte (diff confirms identical).
evidence.craft: Read studio.mjs (861 lines), ai.mjs (162), cli.mjs (52), the AI and export parts of index.html, and the tests. @ts-check throughout, deterministic engine shared by page and CLI, input normalised and clamped on import, no innerHTML anywhere in the page (textContent rendering), page script makes no network calls of its own (a test enforces it), key stored only on opt-in. Defects: the 'Podcast clip clip' label (planCadence name at studio.mjs:414, CLI at cli.mjs:42); the misleading 'no provider configured' error when only the model is missing (ai.mjs:142, page enables the button at index.html aiConfig()); template grammar that does not agree with plural audiences ('Worth knowing if you're independent cafe owners', studio.mjs:578; 'if you're ...' at :681).
evidence.claims: Checked against files: 'X 280 (links count as 23), Threads 500, Bluesky 300 graphemes, LinkedIn 3,000, Instagram 2,200 ...' (backed for Latin text, twitter-text and graphemer agree; not stated that CJK/emoji count double on X); 'anything your time cannot reach is listed, not dropped' (backed: YouTube at 0.5 h lists the long video as not reachable); guide's worked example 6/6/5/3/2 and 176 min (backed, recomputed); 'Reddit never does [carry the offer]' (backed, 0 of 2); 'About one piece in five carries your offer' (observed 25 of 161 = 15.5%, about one in six: partial); CSV 'with a formula-injection guard' (backed); 'any piece that contains a number not present in your interview is thrown away' (README:42, page FAQ index.html:219, guide :82) is not true as written: `node scripts/ai.mjs` keeps 'We now supply two hundred cafes', 'Our cafes saw 3x revenue' (1 to 10 are always allowed, ai.mjs:68) and '90% of cafes switch' (90 from '90 days'), while dropping '14.0 cafes'; 'a Reddit rewrite that adds a link is dropped' (README:42) holds only for http(s) links: 'See juniper.example/tasting' is kept. This is the product's central safety claim ('drafts cannot invent results'), so it binds the score at 2. Disclaimer, no-warranty, best-effort hosting, privacy and AI-label notes are present on both pages and in every export.
evidence.fitness: The job: a small-business owner with 3 to 20 hours a week wants a month of platform-shaped drafts from their own material, and a CSV to load into a scheduler. Walked through with a bakery interview: the plan is sized to the hours and says what is not covered, the 28-day calendar spreads formats with LinkedIn/newsletter/blog on weekdays only (0 weekend slots), every draft fits its platform, the CSV imports cleanly, and nothing is invented. The drafts read as assembled scaffolding a person must edit (expected and said on the page), and the free no-key path is the whole product, which is the right shape. A content strategist could hand this to a client as a starting calendar.
evidence.domain: Compared with platform documentation (X weighted counting via twitter-text, Bluesky grapheme limit, Instagram link-in-bio, Medium canonical import, Reddit self-promotion rules, Meta/TikTok/YouTube AI-label policies) and common short-video practice. Right: limits, link handling, canonical reminder, Reddit drafts carry no link and disclose the business, cadence numbers stated as untested assumptions rather than benchmarks. Departs: (a) the video 'Hook (first 3 seconds)' field allows 150 characters and is filled with the whole first sentence: 33 of 36 video hooks are over 8 words (median 15, max 23), i.e. over 3 s at the tool's own 150 wpm, so the hook a strategist checks first is 6 to 9 s long; (b) Reddit opinion posts put the opinion in the title and give a body with no argument (body = audience line + problem + disclosure), which is the thin post Reddit communities remove; (c) X length ignores CJK/emoji weighting; (d) the AI number gate is digit-only. A senior strategist would sign off the platform rules and the plan, not the video hooks or the Reddit opinion template.

defects.what: The AI 'no invented numbers' gate only sees digits and always allows 1 to 10, so a model reply with 'two hundred cafes', '3x revenue' or a reused '90%' is kept, while the README, the page FAQ and the guide promise that any AI draft containing a number not in the interview is thrown away; this is the product's central claim that drafts cannot invent results

X length counts code points, not X's weighted length: CJK and emoji count 2 on X, so 8 of 32 X posts from a CJK/emoji interview exceed 280 (max 456) while the tool reports them as fitting; the limit is disclosed only in a code comment, not on the page or README
Video 'Hook (first 3 seconds)' is the material's whole first sentence with a 150-character cap: 33 of 36 hooks are over 8 words (median 15, max 23), 6 to 9 s at the tool's own 150 wpm
Reddit rewrite link gate checks only http(s): a scheme-less 'juniper.example/tasting' added by the model is kept, contrary to README 'a Reddit rewrite that adds a link is dropped'
Choosing OpenAI/Gemini/compatible with a key but no model enables the rewrite button and then reports 'AI is off: no provider configured', not that the model is missing
Reddit opinion drafts put the opinion in the title and leave it out of the body (body = audience line, problem, disclosure), the thin post Reddit communities remove
Plan row name for podcast is 'Podcast clip clip' (platform name 'Podcast clip' + format 'Clip'), shown by the CLI plan and in plan notes
README says 'About one piece in five carries your offer'; a 161-draft calendar has 25 offers (15.5%, about one in six) because deep formats and Reddit skip offer angles
Two core rules are untested: dropping '@' from the CSV formula guard and changing the speaking rate 150 -> 100 wpm both leave all 49 tests green
Template wording does not agree with plural audiences: 'Worth knowing if you're independent cafe owners who want...', 'Why I'm telling you this, if you're independent cafe owners'

verdict: A free, no-key interview-to-calendar tool that does what its README says end to end: the plan recomputes by hand (6/6/5/3/2 and 176 min/week for the guide's example), every one of 161 Latin-text drafts fits its platform by X's own twitter-text counter and an independent grapheme counter, the CSV parses cleanly with a working formula guard, the page imports, builds, exports and runs a BYOK rewrite against a mocked Anthropic endpoint with no errors, and 6 of 8 seeded mutants are caught. It misses the bar on claims: the headline promise that any AI draft adding a number not in the interview is thrown away holds only for digits above 10 ('two hundred cafes' and '3x revenue' are kept), and the Reddit no-link gate misses scheme-less links. A content strategist would also send back the video hooks (33 of 36 longer than the 3 seconds their label promises) and would not trust X lengths for CJK or emoji-heavy text. Narrowing the claim wording, or extending the number gate to number words and multipliers, would lift claims to 3.
